# Security Policy

<!--
This file is the pointer GitHub reads for the "Security" tab. The policy
itself lives at the repository root, where it also applies to anyone who
clones the project and does not use GitHub at all.
-->

**See [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) in the repository root.**

In short:

- Report a vulnerability through **GitHub → Security → Report a vulnerability**,
  not as a public issue.
- The project is local-only by design; there is no account, no cloud component
  and no telemetry, so the assets worth protecting are your favourites, your
  listening history and your local ports.
- There is no long-term support branch. Security fixes land on the latest
  release only.
